# UPD-004: Reboot policy is a decision

- **Group:** Updates
- **Severity when it fails:** low
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

Kernel and libc fixes only take effect after a reboot. Either the host reboots itself in a window or a person does it on a routine; leaving both off means a reboot required marker that sits for weeks. The current policy is printed; a reboot pending over 14 days with automatic reboot off warns.

## Verify by hand

```sh
apt-config dump Unattended-Upgrade::Automatic-Reboot; ls -l /var/run/reboot-required
```

## How to fix it

Decide: set Unattended-Upgrade::Automatic-Reboot and a time, or schedule a manual reboot routine.

## What a fix can break

Automatic reboot interrupts every service on the host at the set time.

Run `stackward explain UPD-004` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
